model: ROLEX Sky-Dweller 42 336934 (42 mm steel, white-gold fluted bezel, blue dial, annual calendar ring, Cyclops date, Oyster bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Sky-Dweller 42 template (NEW MODEL, copy of the Datejust 41 step with three ring centres and a rehaut ribbon): case and lugs from the photo silhouette, polished flange + chamfer + 70 real flutes (140 flat facets with the photo's zig-zag at both ends, flatter profile than the Datejust), domed crystal, Cyclops date lens, traced hour / minute outlines and a polygon seconds hand, fluted crown and the three-column Oyster bracelet at the photo's joints; dial, annual calendar ring, month windows, red pointer, indices, print, date numeral, rehaut engraving and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 22.8905 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 880, lug bottom y 2020, crown rows take the mirrored left flank); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: boundary k = 0..139 counter-clockwise from 12 o'clock; long boundaries (odd k: one is exactly at 9 o'clock) reach r 17.41 mm in / 20.33 mm out, short ones 17.999 / 20.24 mm; flange 16.07..17.34 mm (about the bezel centre), outer ends about bezel_out_centre

lens.note: Cyclops: outline = trace.lens_mm (rim outer edge, barrel shaped, about 7.3 x 5.8 mm), rim chamfer 0.18 mm then a flat top inset 0.55 mm; shows the projected photo of the lens

hands.note: hour / minute = traced photo outlines (B - R colour test inside measured ROI polygons), seconds = measured polygon (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons; the lume, black facets and polished edges stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Sky-Dweller crown (no guards): flutes x 1441..1487.5, cap to 1511, axis 0.66 mm below the pivot, radius 3.45 mm

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind. A Jubilee: columns outer / semi / centre / semi / outer, 4 boundaries per bounds row, pieces and z_semi per kind.

bracelet.note: Oyster bracelet: brushed outer links and a wider polished centre link. Joint rows (px, 22.8905 px/mm, pivot (960, 1425)): outer top 748.5, ends 662; outer bottom 2187 / 2368 / 2484.5, end 2537; centre top 861 / 719, end 659; centre bottom 2045 / 2244 / 2406 / 2520, end 2537; column lines x 854.8 / 1063.5. Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette (the bracelet tapers from 21.4 mm at the lugs).

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
